identifier_policy: All SOURCE_TERM_* names are proposed symbolic IDs; no integer enum or runtime registry has been added.

default_groups.activation: momentum equations always implicit in current partition, including zero rheology

default_groups.execution_order: existing post-stage EX evaluation / boundary evaluation within spatial reconstruction

default_groups.activation: current mass-exchange outer guards and per-cell cutoff
default_groups.execution_order: after completed RK, before advancing runtime time

scheduling_contracts: Group ID identifies a group; execution_order and stage phase determine scheduling. Stage id=1 cannot name both explicit and analytic groups.
No duplicate physical contribution across stage/step; dependent assembly and full-law analytic bundles consume existing term IDs without a second application.
One analytic target may be scalar or vector velocity block; exactly one solver per normalized analytic group.
Legacy mixed analytic groups normalize in actual velocity -> temperature -> pore order, refreshing state after each target.
Legacy shared Newton groups retain their jointly solved equation block; independent ordered solves require explicit block metadata and compatibility validation.
Default cell-source and mass-exchange summation/limiter batches remain atomic until separately validated term-selective kernels exist.
excluded_from_additive_source_registry: Hydrostatic pressure and ordinary bed-slope nonconservative spatial path; retain existing HP/PCCU discretization.
Stochastic OU preparation/evolution, geometric reconstruction and output; preserve their scheduling around sources.
Friction stopping/projections, dry-cell corrections and mass positivity checks are numerical application policies, not additional physical rates.
